audit_findings.title: The FY2025 anchor may retain large nonrecurring gains
audit_findings.magnitude: $897 million pretax disclosed gains, equal to 35.3% of the $2.5444 billion anchor; after-tax valuation effect unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Any gains retained in FY2025 owner earnings raise the anchor and are capitalized through every forecast year and terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: In 2025, total items not allocated to segments of $1.17 billion primarily includes gain on sale of assets of $897 million, which includes gains from the BANGL Acquisition of $484 million, the Ethanol Joint Venture Sale of $254 million and the divestiture of the Rockies operations of $159 million.
audit_findings.explanation: The nonrecurring gains are demonstrated, but their retention in the anchor is not. Because their disclosed pretax amount is more than one-third of anchor OE, failure to remove them could materially overstate value. The $253 million legal settlements and $57 million SRE credit create additional normalization exposure.
audit_findings.action: Produce the FY2025 OE line-item reconciliation and identify the attributable after-tax treatment of the $484 million BANGL gain, $254 million Ethanol JV gain, $159 million Rockies gain, $253 million settlements and $57 million SRE credit; rerun if any remain.

audit_findings.title: Parent earnings may be mixed with consolidated MPLX cash-flow adjustments
audit_findings.magnitude: unquantified; filed scale includes $1.831 billion of 2025 net income attributable to noncontrolling interests and approximately 36% public ownership of MPLX
audit_findings.mechanism: Using MPC-attributable net income with 100% consolidated D&A, maintenance capital and working-capital adjustments mismatches the OE numerator with the MPC-share denominator.
audit_findings.evidence: Due to our ownership of the general partner interest, we have determined that we control MPLX and therefore we consolidate MPLX and record a noncontrolling interest for the interest owned by the public.
audit_findings.explanation: MPLX consolidation and the public minority claim are demonstrated; inconsistent construction of OE is not yet demonstrated. A 100% D&A add-back could overstate MPC OE, while subtracting 100% maintenance capital or working-capital investment could understate it. The filed minority-income scale makes the unresolved basis mismatch reasonably capable of materially changing value.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile every 2025 D&A, maintenance-capex, working-capital and other cash-flow adjustment to MPC common holders, or rebuild OE consistently from consolidated earnings with the public MPLX claim deducted, then rerun all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: The stakes bridge may double count equity-method businesses
audit_findings.magnitude: $6.968 billion bridge addition, equal to $24.68 per share and 13.8% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Equity-method earnings enter net income and OE, while the investees' value is also added through stakes_net; absent an OE purge, both the income stream and asset value are counted.
audit_findings.evidence: Income from equity method investments represents our proportionate share of net income generated by the equity method investees.
audit_findings.explanation: The inclusion of equity-method income in reported earnings and the $6.968 billion stakes addition are demonstrated. Whether all associated earnings and cash-flow adjustments were removed from OE is unresolved. The bridge addition alone is large enough to materially alter the per-share valuation if duplicated.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile stakes_net investment by investment against the latest $7.197 billion filed equity-method-investment balance and document removal from anchor OE of related income, distributions, D&A and maintenance investment; rerun the bridge and OE if overlap exists.

audit_findings.title: The null perimeter may project a mixed, partial-year portfolio
audit_findings.mechanism: Partial-year acquired operations and financing costs can understate current-perimeter OE, while earnings from the disposed Rockies assets can overstate it; transaction gains affect normalization separately.
audit_findings.evidence: On August 29, 2025, MPLX completed the acquisition of 100 percent of Northwind Midstream for $2.4 billion in cash.
audit_findings.explanation: The acquisition and disposal dates demonstrate that FY2025 is a mixed-period portfolio, but the record does not quantify attributable, after-tax current-perimeter OE. The directions offset, and the filings state that separate pro forma acquisition results were not material for disclosure, so materiality to this valuation cannot presently be established.
audit_findings.action: Prepare an attributable current-perimeter OE bridge that annualizes Northwind, BANGL and Whiptail operations and financing, removes Rockies operations after disposal, and excludes transaction and remeasurement gains; compare the result with the $2.5444 billion anchor and rerun if material.

audit_findings.title: BANGL contingent consideration is an omitted claim ahead of common equity
audit_findings.magnitude: $235 million recorded liability at June 30, 2026, equal to $0.83 per share and 0.47% of base equity value; $275 million cap equals $0.97 per share
audit_findings.mechanism: The seller earnout is a claim ahead of MPC common equity and requires a bridge deduction unless already captured elsewhere.
audit_findings.evidence: The earnout payment will continue to be remeasured at fair value each quarter with changes in fair value recognized in earnings until either the EBITDA targets are met or the earnout period ends, with the total payout capped at $ 275 million.
audit_findings.explanation: The recorded liability and its absence from the enumerated bridge are demonstrated. Deducting the latest $235 million carrying amount would reduce base value by only $0.83 per share, versus reported base value of $178.85 and a market price of $387.71, so it cannot change the valuation conclusion by itself.
audit_findings.action: Confirm that the June 30, 2026 $235 million liability is not embedded elsewhere, deduct it from the equity bridge, and run a $275 million capped-payment sensitivity consistent with any growth that triggers the earnout.

audit_findings.title: Terminal value may ignore unrecognized retirement obligations
audit_findings.mechanism: Unfunded closure, dismantlement and hazardous-material costs would reduce terminal cash flows or require a separate terminal equity deduction.
audit_findings.evidence: Asset retirement obligations have not been recognized for some assets because the fair value cannot be reasonably estimated since the settlement dates of the obligations are indeterminate.
audit_findings.explanation: The existence of retirement obligations for which no liability is recognized is demonstrated, but settlement dates and fair values are indeterminate. Because terminal value supplies 46.3%–50.9% of operating PV, inadequate terminal maintenance or closure provisioning could affect value, but the record cannot establish the amount or materiality.
audit_findings.action: Obtain an asset-level estimate or reasonable range for unrecognized refinery, terminal, pipeline and processing closure obligations, assess coverage by terminal maintenance capital, and rerun terminal value with any uncovered present-value amount.

audit_findings.title: Unidentified D&A is conservatively left in owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: $58.0 million in FY2017, equal to 2.7% of filed FY2017 D&A and 3.4% of FY2017 OE; $0 current valuation effect
audit_findings.mechanism: Leaving eligible D&A unadded would understate FY2017 OE, but the valuation uses FY2025 latest actual as its anchor rather than a historical trend.
audit_findings.evidence: identified eligible D&A is below the filed composite; residual is conservatively left as an expense, not added back: FY2017 $58.0m (2.7% of filed D&A)
audit_findings.explanation: The residual treatment is conservative and affects only FY2017 in the supplied finding. Even if all $58 million were eligible, it would raise FY2017 OE by only 3.4% and would not change the $2.5444 billion FY2025 anchor or the current scenario values under the stated method.
audit_findings.action: Classify the FY2017 residual for record completeness; rerun only if the valuation later uses a historical trend or filed evidence identifies a comparable unresolved residual in FY2025 anchor OE.
